//events: Event names are HOST-SPECIFIC. Verified live in VS Code Copilot Chat by registering both casings and observing which fired: PostToolUse fires, postToolUse does NOT. sessionEnd and SessionEnd never fire (even after a full VS Code quit); Stop fires after every completed turn. camelCase sessionStart/preToolUse/userPromptSubmitted do fire. Register BOTH spellings so the hook works on either host - a duplicate fire is harmless, a missed one is silent. See docs/reference/hook-payloads.md.
